preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100000 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(S.islower() and S.isalpha() for S in Ss)
preconditions.description: Each string S contains only lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][0] == 'YES' if can_form_palindrome(Ss[i]) else output[i][0] == 'NO' for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The first line of each output is 'YES' if the string can be transformed into a palindrome, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][1] == min_swaps_to_palindrome(Ss[i]) if can_form_palindrome(Ss[i]) else True for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: The second line of each output is the minimum number of swaps required to transform the string into a palindrome if possible.
